response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_remaining_gb) OVER () AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, avg_remaining_gb, avg_cpu_gpu_gap, avg_remaining_gb / mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean FROM m WHERE mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (avg_remaining_gb / mean_avg) IS NULL, (avg_remaining_gb / mean_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
